title: Meghadūta

1.1.hook: A lover in exile. A cloud as his messenger.

word.en: separation from the one you love
word.note: Inside the compound kāntā-viraha-guruṇā, “heavy with separation from his beloved”. The whole poem grows from it.

1.2.hook:
Months alone on a mountain.
Then, on the first day of the rains, a cloud.

word.note: Here megham, the cloud he sees clinging to the peak. The poem is named for it: Megha-dūta, the cloud messenger.

1.3.hook:
One look at a rain cloud,
and even a happy heart aches.

word.note: antar, within, and bāṣpa, tears: standing before the cloud, he holds his tears back.
